description: Search questions across a Stack Exchange site. Returns ranked questions with title, score, answer count, accepted status, tags, ask and last-activity dates, and a short excerpt of the question body — not the full body. Results supply question_id values for stackexchange_get_thread, which fetches the full question body and all answers. Results past the pageSize cap are reachable with the `page` parameter. Use the `site` parameter to target a specific community (e.g. "stackoverflow", "superuser", "unix"); call stackexchange_list_sites to discover valid site values.

acceptedOnly.description: When true, return only questions that have an accepted answer.

minScore.description: Minimum question score — excludes questions with lower scores. Setting minScore orders results by score (votes), which may differ from the requested sort.

page.description: Page of results to return, 1-based (default 1). Page 2 with pageSize 10 returns results 11–20. Each page is a separate upstream call and costs one API quota unit, which matters on the keyless 300/day tier. Without STACKEXCHANGE_API_KEY, Stack Exchange refuses any page above 25.

pageSize.description: Number of results to return (1–30, default 10).

query.description: Full-text search query (e.g. "python async generator send value").

site.description: Stack Exchange site to search — use the api_site_parameter value (e.g. "stackoverflow", "superuser", "serverfault"). Defaults to "stackoverflow". Call stackexchange_list_sites to discover valid values.

sort.description: Result ordering: "relevance" (default, best match), "votes" (highest score first), "activity" (most recently active), "newest" (most recently created).

tags.description: Filter results to questions with all specified tags.

items.description: A single tag to filter by (e.g. "python", "async").

name: stackexchange_search_questions

attribution.description: Content license notice. Stack Exchange content is licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 and requires attribution.

cap.description: The pageSize cap applied to this request.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_site`: The provided site value is not a valid Stack Exchange network site identifier. `invalid_parameter`: Stack Exchange rejected a request parameter and named the field rather than reporting a bad site. `quota_exceeded`: The Stack Exchange API quota_remaining has reached 0. `paging_depth_limit`: Stack Exchange refused the requested page because paging above page 25 needs a key. `invalid_api_key`: Stack Exchange does not recognize the API key this server is configured with. `upstream_unavailable`: Stack Exchange answered with a body that is not the expected JSON envelope. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Actionable guidance when results are empty or filtered.

page.description: The 1-based page these results came from — 1 when the input omitted page.

questions.description: Questions matching the search query, ordered by the specified sort.

items.description: A Stack Exchange question with score, answer count, tags, dates, and optional excerpt.

creationDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the question was asked — use it to judge whether the advice is still current.

excerpt.description: Opening prose of the question body, trimmed to roughly 300 characters and ending in "…" when cut. Code blocks and markdown structure are omitted; absent when the question body is nothing but code.

isAnswered.description: True when the question has an accepted answer or at least one positively-scored answer.

lastActivityDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent activity on the question (edit, answer, or comment).

questionId.description: Question ID — pass to stackexchange_get_thread to fetch the full thread.

items.description: A tag applied to this question.

quotaMax.description: Maximum API quota calls per day (300 keyless, ~10,000 with API key).

quotaRemaining.description: Remaining API quota calls for the current day.

truncated.description: True when results were capped at pageSize.

title: Search Stack Exchange Questions
